name: Slice Selling Agent
description: AI-powered agent for customer requirement assessment, providing relevant 5G network slice product options and managing the negotiation lifecycle.

skills.name: Slice Offering Query
skills.description: Assess customer connectivity requirements and recommend appropriate 5G network slice offerings based on bandwidth, latency, and coverage needs.

skills.name: Slice Negotiation
skills.description: Manage the B2B negotiation lifecycle for network slice contracts including SLA terms, pricing, and coverage parameters.

skills.name: SLA Validation
skills.description: Validate proposed SLA parameters against available network capacity, coverage maps, and existing commitments before contract finalization.

skills.name: Pricing Optimization
skills.description: Generate optimized pricing recommendations based on customer segment, usage patterns, contract duration, and competitive positioning.

skills.name: Upsell Recommendation
skills.description: Identify upsell opportunities based on current slice utilization, customer growth trajectory, and available premium service tiers.
